title: A European Energy Provider Transformed Its Technology Through an Integrated Customer Experience Management Platform
summary: Read how a renewable energy leader streamlined service and boosted satisfaction by transforming its customer experience management platform.
body_markdown:
The client launched a comprehensive transformation program to simplify customer management and bring previously fragmented processes and capabilities together. Working collaboratively with Concentrix, it integrated customer management functionality into a single platform designed around the realities of day-to-day operations.


#### [iX Hello™](https://www.concentrix.com/ix-hello/) All-In-One Customer Experience Management Platform


At the center of the transformation was iX Hello™, a unified customer experience management platform that connected customer service workflows, advisors, management, and data. By replacing fragmented processes with a more connected operating environment, the client could simplify service delivery while giving management real-time data to support faster, better-informed decisions.


#### Advisor Empowerment and Productivity


Smart contact allocation, gamification, and simplified workflows helped advisors stay productive and engaged. An intuitive portal reduced the number and complexity of actions required, lowering training requirements and enabling advisors to take greater ownership of customer issues from first contact through resolution.


#### Innovation and New Opportunities


With customer and operational data brought together, the client gained a stronger foundation for developing new energy products and services. This supported sustainable growth while helping customers progress toward net zero.


#### From Fragmented Service to Connected Resolution


Previously, advisors had to navigate multiple systems to resolve customer issues, creating friction for both employees and customers. The integrated platform enabled a more proactive and efficient service model across the customer journey:


- **Pre-emptive Resolution:** Using data insights to help the client anticipate and proactively resolve issues before customers are aware.
- **Intelligent Auto-Resolution:** Enabling contact deflection, AI intervention, omnichannel self-service, and intelligent routing.
- **Efficient Contact Resolution by Advisors:** Providing advisors with tools (including AI) to empower them to take ownership of customer issues from start to resolution.
